_comment: 生成物，别手改。scripts/export-codex.ts 从 data/vanilla/units 与 vanilla-assets.json 生成。

desc.zh: 万物皆应平衡，正所谓暗与明、月与阳、雄与雌一般
desc.en: There must be balance in all things: dark and light, moon and sun, female and male.

desc.zh: 不动如山！随着时间的推移，这股力量会愈发强大，直至不可撼动
desc.en: Become like the mountain: immovable, stronger over time, and nigh-on impossible to assail.

desc.zh: 在以集群方式作战、畅饮与大吃大嚼时，这些军队会更为勇悍，虽然这种『勇悍』仅能持续不长的一段时间
desc.en: These troops are emboldened when fighting, drinking and feasting together, although such ‘bravery’ is only temporary at best.

desc.zh: 当进行近战时，这支部队会尽量保持阵型，从而少量增加近战防御
desc.en: The unit will try to stay in formation when in melee. Melee defence will be slightly increased.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以隐蔽在森林里，除非敌人走到近前，否则他们不会被发现
desc.en: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

desc.zh: 此部队的武道宁和为阳
desc.en: This unit counts as a Yang unit for the purpose of Battle Harmony proximity
